movie.title: Mi Amor
movie.overview: Romy is a French DJ touring the sun-bleached and club-lit Canary Islands, until her friend vanishes. Met with evasion from locals and the authorities, her search leads her to a magnetic stranger and the sinister proprietors of an exotic animal sanctuary.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When her friend mysteriously disappears during a DJ tour in the Canary Islands, Romy must navigate local hostility and a web of secrets that lead to a magnetic stranger and a sinister exotic animal sanctuary.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: French DJ Romy is on tour across the sun-drenched, club-filled Canary Islands when her friend suddenly vanishes without a trace. Frustrated by the stonewalling tactics of both local authorities and residents, she embarks on her own desperate investigation. Her search brings her into the orbit of an alluring stranger and exposes the dark underbelly of a local exotic animal sanctuary.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Romy, a talented French DJ, arrives in the Canary Islands for a high-energy nightlife tour set against a backdrop of sun-bleached beaches and pulsating clubs. The exciting atmosphere turns nightmarish when her close friend suddenly goes missing after a night out. When Romy tries to get help, she is met with cold indifference, evasion, and bureaucratic stonewalling from local officials and residents alike. Refusing to give up, Romy launches her own investigation through the unfamiliar terrain and underground party scene. Along the way, she crosses paths with a magnetic stranger whose motives remain dangerously ambiguous. As the two dig deeper into the mystery, the clues lead away from the nightlife scene and toward a secluded exotic animal sanctuary. Behind the sanctuary's idyllic facade, Romy uncovers a sinister network managed by treacherous proprietors. Navigating escalating threat and deceit, she must risk her own safety to uncover the truth behind her friend's disappearance before it is too late.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set against the vibrant contrast of sun-drenched Mediterranean landscapes and neon-lit electronic music venues, 'Mi Amor' is a gripping thriller centered on Romy, a touring French DJ. Romy's life is upended when her traveling companion disappears, leaving no trace behind. As Romy tries to piece together the events leading up to the disappearance, she hits a wall of secrecy from both tight-lipped locals and unhelpful authorities. Her relentless pursuit of answers draws her deeper into a complex web of lies, bringing her into contact with an enigmatic stranger who becomes an ally in her search. Together, they trace the missing friend's final movements, leading them to a remote exotic animal sanctuary. Beneath the surface of this unusual establishment lies a dark, dangerous reality that threatens everyone who gets too close.

story_structure.climax: Romy confronts the sinister operators of the sanctuary as the harrowing reality behind her friend's disappearance and the sanctuary's true operation comes to light.
story_structure.conflict: Her journey takes a sudden turn when her friend mysteriously disappears, and both local residents and authorities prove dismissive and unhelpful.
story_structure.resolution: In the aftermath of the ordeal, Romy deals with the consequences of her discoveries and seeks closure as her time in the Canary Islands comes to an end.
story_structure.introduction: Romy, a French DJ, arrives in the vibrant, sun-soaked Canary Islands for a high-energy tour of the local nightlife and club scene.
story_structure.risingAction: Determined to find answers, Romy pushes deeper into the islands' underbelly, crossing paths with a charismatic stranger and tracing clues to an isolated, exotic animal sanctuary.
